text: मैच के 8वें मिनट में विक्टर क्विनलन ने पेनाल्टी से गोल करके किंग्समूर FC को 1-0 की बढ़त दिलाई[#152]. इस पेनाल्टी का xG 0.76 था, यानी ऐसा मौका लगभग 10 में 7 से 8 बार गोल में बदलता है. इससे पहले 7वें मिनट में जूल साटो ने फाउल किया जो इस पेनाल्टी का कारण बना[#151]. वेस्टपोर्ट एल्बियन के पास ज्यादा गेंद थी लेकिन गोल करने का मौका कम मिला.

- Westport Albion had greater possession at 53.8%, but only 0.21 xG and no shots on target before the goal.

- The build-up to the goal was extremely brief and initiated directly from the penalty spot with no passes or prolonged possession, indicating it was a set piece situation rather than a tactical pattern like pressing or counter-attack.
- Kingsmoor FC, playing a 4-4-2 formation with a style emphasizing wide, crossing play, benefited from exploiting Westport Albion’s errors to take the lead early, though this goal was not from open play or a crossing chance but from opposition foul.
- Westport Albion, also set up in 4-4-2 but favoring direct, vertical passing and enjoying greater possession and field tilt (53.8% and 70.6% respectively), were caught out defensively early on, reflected by their foul leading to the penalty and three high turnovers in the first 10 minutes.
